raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Physical size of the square domain",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies a square with 64×64 square elements, but gives no physical side length L.",
      "readings": [
        "Domain [0,1]×[0,1], with element side h=1/64",
        "Domain [0,64]×[0,64], with element side h=1"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Row 1 support configuration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 allows 1–4 fixed point or segment constraints at corner/midpoint anchors. Neither Sec. 5 nor the Fig. 3 caption identifies row 1's count, locations, or spans.",
      "readings": [
        "One fixed segment covering the entire left edge",
        "Two fixed points at (0,0) and (0,L)",
        "Three constraints: the lower half of the left edge and both right-hand corners",
        "Four fixed points, one at each corner"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Row 1 external load location",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 places one load on the boundary; Eq. 25 names its coordinates. No coordinates or selected edge are supplied for row 1.",
      "readings": [
        "(x_load,y_load)=(L,L/2)",
        "(x_load,y_load)=(L,L/4)",
        "(x_load,y_load)=(L/2,L)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial application of the unit load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 says a single load is applied 'along the edge'; it does not specify its footprint or conversion into nodal forces.",
      "readings": [
        "Concentrated force at one boundary node",
        "Point force at a continuous boundary coordinate, interpolated between adjacent boundary nodes",
        "Uniform traction over a two-element boundary patch, with resultant magnitude one",
        "Uniform traction over the selected entire edge, with resultant magnitude one"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Row 1 unit-load direction",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 states that direction is sampled randomly; row 1's angle or force components are not reported.",
      "readings": [
        "(F_x,F_y)=(1,0)",
        "(F_x,F_y)=(0,-1)",
        "(F_x,F_y)=(1/√2,-1/√2)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Row 1 prescribed volume fraction",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 supplies only the sampling interval 0.3–0.5, not the value used for row 1.",
      "readings": [
        "f=0.30",
        "f=0.40",
        "f=0.50"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Non-design material or void masks",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2 and 4.1 do not explicitly identify passive cells or establish whether load/support attachment regions remain designable.",
      "readings": [
        "All 4096 cells are designable; no passive regions",
        "Cells immediately adjacent to load and support nodes are forced solid",
        "Two-cell-deep attachment pads at loads and supports are forced solid; other cells remain designable"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Absolute solid stiffness E_0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 2 introduces E_0 without assigning it a value. Its absolute scale is undetermined independently of the separately unspecified void-to-solid stiffness ratio.",
      "readings": [
        "E_0=1 in consistent normalized units",
        "E_0=70 GPa, holding E_min/E_0 fixed",
        "E_0=210 GPa, holding E_min/E_0 fixed"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid constitutive law and Poisson ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 gives an E-based interpolation but no Poisson ratio or complete elastic constitutive tensor.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic elasticity with ν=0.20",
        "Isotropic elasticity with ν=0.30",
        "Grid-aligned orthotropic plane-stress elasticity with E_x=E_0, E_y=0.5E_0, G_xy=0.2E_0 and ν_xy=0.25; SIMP scales the entire stiffness tensor"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional elastic reduction",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 calls the problem two-dimensional but does not specify the out-of-plane kinematic assumption.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The two-dimensional formulation in Secs. 2 and 4.1 supplies no thickness or per-unit-thickness convention.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.01L",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.1L"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Residual void stiffness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 2 introduces E_min to avoid singular stiffness matrices, but neither Sec. 2 nor Sec. 4.1 specifies E_min/E_0.",
      "readings": [
        "E_min/E_0=10^-9",
        "E_min/E_0=10^-6",
        "E_min/E_0=10^-3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element interpolation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1–4.2 determine the 64×64 uniform square-cell grid, but not element order, nodal interpolation, or quadrature.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2×2 Gauss integration",
        "Eight-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3×3 Gauss integration",
        "Nine-node biquadratic quadrilaterals with 3×3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density or sensitivity filtering",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2 and 4.1 report no filter choice, radius, weighting kernel, or treatment at domain boundaries; h denotes element side length.",
      "readings": [
        "No filter",
        "Linear-cone sensitivity filter with radius 1.5h, truncated and renormalized at boundaries",
        "Linear-cone density filter with radius 3h, truncated and renormalized at boundaries",
        "Helmholtz density filter with length parameter 1.5h and homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density projection during optimization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 discusses penalization and final thresholding, but does not state whether an additional projection is used during the 100 optimization steps.",
      "readings": [
        "No projection during optimization",
        "Smooth Heaviside projection with β=1 and threshold 0.5",
        "Smooth Heaviside projection with β=8 and threshold 0.5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial SIMP density field",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 assumes full material for conditioning-field FEA, but does not explicitly identify that field as the SIMP optimization initialization.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform initial density ρ_e=f",
        "Uniform initial density ρ_e=1",
        "A small spatial perturbation about f, preserving mean density f"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization density floor",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 9 imposes ρ_min, but its value is not assigned. The general bounds in Eqs. 1 and 6 do not determine this implementation floor.",
      "readings": [
        "ρ_min=0",
        "ρ_min=0.001",
        "ρ_min=0.01"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density-update parameters m and η",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 10 requires positive m and η, but Sec. 4.1 supplies no numerical values for the dataset optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "m=1, η=0.5",
        "m=1, η=1",
        "m=0.2, η=0.5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Numerical enforcement of the volume constraint",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 says λ is adjusted to satisfy Eq. 11, but gives no search procedure or numerical volume tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Bracketed bisection to relative volume error below 10^-3",
        "Bracketed bisection to relative volume error below 10^-6",
        "A safeguarded root solve to relative volume error below 10^-10"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Finite-element equilibrium solve",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 4 specifies equilibrium, but Secs. 2 and 4.1 give no linear-solver method or residual tolerance for the repeated analyses.",
      "readings": [
        "Double-precision direct factorization",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 10^-8",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 10^-4"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Conversion of the final SIMP densities into the displayed binary map",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 requires thresholding and Sec. 4.1 stores binary maps, but neither gives the threshold or a volume-preserving selection rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Solid where ρ_e≥0.5",
        "Solid where ρ_e≥0.3",
        "Keep the round(4096f) highest-density cells solid"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
